Type: bench
Name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Glam Tufted Seat Upholstered Bench with Gold Legs , 58"L, Gold Finish
Colors: Gold
Materials: Metal
This simple upholstered bench can be played up or down, depending on your taste. The gold finish is handsome but not too shiny. Use it at the foot of your bed or anywhere else you'd like to add a touch of glam. 58"L X 18"W X 19"D Metal with gold finish, polyester fabric Modern and simple yet distinctive design Perfect as a comfortable bench or a place to lay an extra blanket Assemble in 15-30 minutes. Wipe with soft dry cloth. Free returns for 30 days. 1-year warranty.
